Edit the trials on the Data sheet; statistics, fit and charts update. Method and notes are on the Notebook sheet.

sheets.name: Notebook
cells: Lab notebook: how far does a spring stretch?
How does the extension of a steel spring depend on the mass hung from it?
Extension is proportional to load (Hooke's law) while the spring stays within its elastic limit.
Load, in grams, in steps of 25 g from 25 g to 600 g.
Extension of the spring in centimetres, read from a fixed metre rule.
Same spring, same rule, same hanger, 30 seconds of settling before each reading, room temperature 21 C.
Five trials at every load. The mean and the standard deviation of the five readings are used in the analysis.
The rule reads to 0.1 cm, so the error bars on the scatter chart show a 3 percent relative uncertainty. Change it in the chart options.
Replace the trial columns on the Data sheet with your own measurements. The slope, intercept, R squared, residuals and every chart on the Dashboard recalculate.
